newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won ends flat, central bank supports.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won ends flat, central bank supports.

text.p: The won finished flat versus the dollar on Monday after central bank intervention helped the currency recoup earlier losses, traders said.
The central bank came in repeatedly to stop the won from falling below 845, they said. But the bank denied the move, as it generally does.
The won closed at 844.70, unchanged from the opening. It fluctuated in a range of 844.30 to 845.20.
Traders said usual import deals and the dollar's strength against the Japanese yen in the global market sparked dollar buying throughout the day.
They said the won could have fallen further if not for the central bank support.
"The dollar will test 845 again tomorrow," said a local dealer.
The base mid-rate is seen at 844.70 for Tuesday, compared with 842.70 on Monday.
